remarks: On a single loaded location at the end of a culdesac, this beautifully appointed 55+ residence offers a premium lot and thoughtfully curated upgrades and details. Effortless resort-style living with an owned solar system, custom window coverings including plantation shutters and roman shades and luxury vinyl plank flooring and designer carpet throughout. At the heart of the home, a chef-inspired kitchen pairs crisp white shaker cabinetry with marbleized white quartz countertops and a beautiful backsplash.
